submitted.rationale: I spread the 3 merit measurements across the Co-rich (0), Mn-rich (104) and Ca-rich (54) regions. All three gave photocurrents near zero. Index 54 had the highest value (+1e-8 A), so it is my pick, though the lead is marginal. The MEGNet gaps (Co3O4 about 0.02 eV HSE, 0.7 eV SCAN) gave no useful ranking.

rejected.reason: Measured -0.0 A; the Co-rich region is a narrow-gap Co3O4-like absorber
Measured -2e-8 A; the Mn-rich corner gave no photoanodic response

consultations.verdict: Uninformative: MEGNet gives near-zero HSE gaps for Co3O4 (mp-18748) and mp-19201, which is not realistic for these oxides. Without a stability or gap ranking, I'll spread coverage and start on the Co-rich side (index 0, also the GP's pick).

Uninformative: the gap is small and not discriminating. The Co-rich film gave zero photocurrent, so I'm moving to the Mn-rich corner (index 104), where Mn oxides are more plausible absorbers at 2.4 eV.

Against Co-rich films: SCAN puts the Co3O4 gap at 0.7 eV, a narrow-gap, recombination-prone absorber. The Co-rich and Mn-rich corners both gave about zero, so I'm using the last measurement on the unexplored Ca-rich region (index 54).
